title: Thorny Thicket
subtitle: Life finds a way, as it always has.

trails.title: An Unexpected Conversation
trails.description: See? Learning a new language always pays off sooner or later.

trails.title: Disagreement
trails.description: Three heads—one turns left, one turns right, and one doesn't move at all.

items.text: Thorny Thicket
Foundation Office

items.speaker: Soldier I
items.text: Have you lost your mind? Get out from under there, now.
He trembles in his checkered uniform, frozen in a corner. The paleness of his face is rivaled only by his white knuckles as he grips a stack of papers for dear life.

items.speaker: Soldier I
items.text: Forget your bloody paperwork. Just get somewhere safe.

items.speaker: Registrar
items.text: Those things out there ... Are-Are they ...

items.speaker: Soldier I
items.text: Yeah. Nowhere's safe anymore. Welcome to reality, sunshine.

items.speaker: Soldier I
items.text: Now get on your feet and help me move this table outside. We need to barricade this place.

items.speaker: Registrar
items.text: Wh-What about those monsters? What do we do about them?

items.speaker: Soldier I
items.text: We put a bullet through their heads, if we're lucky.
The soldier pauses, realizing in that moment the reason for the young man's terror.

items.speaker: Soldier I
items.text: For Pete's sake, don't tell me this is your first time seeing the Manus up close.
The terrified young man nods. Years of experience and long tenure in the Foundation's bureaucracy count for little in this moment.

items.speaker: Soldier I
items.text: Well, I'll be damned. I fight these things every day, and half of you checkerheads haven't even seen one in the flesh!

items.speaker: Soldier I
items.text: Listen, if all you're going to do is stand there shaking, then I'm leaving without you. I've got to try to find my team.

items.speaker: Registrar
items.text: No, wait, wait! Please, don't leave me here.

items.speaker: Soldier I
items.text: Alright, then what are you going to do?
The registrar finally pries himself up from the corner.

items.speaker: Registrar
items.text: I'll come with you. Let's move this table outside.
Fourth Floor, Committee Building

items.speaker: Soldier I
items.text: Just a little more.

items.speaker: Registrar
items.text: Ugh!
Outside the office, staff dressed in checkered uniforms flit around like a startled flock of birds, their "wings" flapping without any clear direction.

items.speaker: Irinei
items.text: Non-combatant staff must evacuate to higher floors immediately. Clear the main stairwell—military use only.

items.speaker: Foundation Staff Member I
items.text: No, no. Don't jump. This is the fourth floor.

items.speaker: Foundation Staff Member II
items.text: Out of the way. Soldier, find me a weapon.

items.speaker: Irinei
items.text: Enough. We don't need file clerks wasting ammunition. Just find somewhere safe with the rest of your colleagues.
Amid the flurry of documents stand several operation team members, calm and composed.

items.speaker: Operation Team Leader I
items.text: Looks like you're free for now, Creius.

items.speaker: Creius
items.text: For the moment, yes. The trial will start up again once this all blows over, assuming we're still alive.

items.speaker: Creius
items.text: Where's my squad?

items.speaker: Operation Team Leader I
items.text: They're with the Quick Reaction Force that was sent to the SPDM. We've lost contact with all our operatives in the field.

items.speaker: Creius
items.text: I suppose that makes me the sole member of the "XII," then.

items.speaker: Operation Team Leader II
items.text: We've attempted to reach "Razor" and the others, but so far we've got nothing. They may have gotten cut off downstairs.

items.speaker: Creius
items.text: What's the ETA on reinforcements?

items.speaker: Constantine
items.text: Fifteen minutes.
Constantine hasn't left her post yet, but the front line creeps closer to her door each moment.

items.speaker: Constantine
items.text: Inform everyone you can reach: air support is on its way.

items.speaker: Creius
items.text: With respect, ma'am, you ought to at least be giving your captains the hard truth.

items.speaker: Constantine
items.text: Forces are an hour out, maybe more. Until then, we hold the line. Understood?

items.speaker: Creius
items.text: Understood. Reinforcement ETA: 60 minutes.

items.speaker: Z
items.text: Ma'am, we have representatives from the House of Integratus waiting. They request a brief meeting.

items.speaker: Constantine
items.text: I'm on my way. Best of luck, soldiers.

items.speaker: Z
items.text: Godspeed, officers.
With that, the gathered politicians hurry away.

items.speaker: Operation Team Leader II
items.text: Plan's simple. We let them push up, layering out a defense in depth, giving ground as necessary to conserve ammo and avoid exposure to the "Storm."

items.speaker: Operation Team Leader II
items.text: Priority for now is to buy time for all non-combatant staff to reach the top floor. If reinforcements don't come in time to save our necks, then at least we'll die standing.
He pats Creius's shoulder.

items.speaker: Operation Team Leader II
items.text: The Dispatch Center will be coordinating our teams to focus on the Manus's arcanist troops. You coming with us, Creius?

items.speaker: Creius
items.text: The "XII" Squad always stands ready, even if I'm the only one left.

items.speaker: Creius
items.text: Let's move out.
Their team moves through fleeing bureaucrats and takes the stairs down toward the ever-nearing battle.
Third Floor, Committee Building

items.speaker: Foundation Security
items.text: Get down!
Thick cement manages to block a fatal incantation.
Crouching low behind cover, Creius makes his way to the commander's side.

items.speaker: Creius
items.text: We're from Special Operations. What's the situation here?

items.speaker: Foundation Security
items.text: We've lost the second floor. The Manus are pushing up the main stairs.

items.speaker: Foundation Security
items.text: We've got nothing reliable on their numbers or composition, sir. At this rate, I doubt we can hold the third floor for long.

items.speaker: Foundation Security
items.text: Dispatch told us reinforcements are coming. What's their ETA?

items.speaker: Creius
items.text: Um. We need you to hold on for 15 minutes. Understood, soldier? Spread the word.

items.speaker: Foundation Security
items.text: Fifteen minutes. We can manage that.
The defenders steel themselves and fight with renewed vigor. Their flagging morale is centering on a single clear goal: 15 minutes, hold the line. That's it.
At the far end of the room, a Manus soldier leaps out of cover. Both sides are close enough to make out each other's expressions.

items.speaker: Krutov
items.text: They're stalling for time. Push through.

items.speaker: Krutov
items.text: We have numbers on them. They won't hold. Units Two and Three, probe for any weak points in their defenses.

items.speaker: Manus Soldier I
items.text: Yes, sir.
Krutov's soldiers push forward with a discipline far exceeding that of normal arcanists.

items.speaker: Krutov
items.text: We're behind schedule. These Foundation dogs have finally found their footing.

items.speaker: Krutov
items.text: Where is İlmek? She was supposed to be leading the vanguard. Late? Or simply proving herself useless again?

items.speaker: Krutov
items.text: What is it now?
The tremors were not part of the plan, but Krutov has grown used to his fanatical arcanist troops acting of their own accord.

items.speaker: Krutov
items.text: Whose arcane skill was that? Imbeciles! If there can be anything said for humans, at least they can follow a plan.
He storms out of cover, two arcanists leaping with him to serve as his bodyguards.
Krutov arrives at the outermost corridor, planning to find the source of the tremors for himself.

items.speaker: Krutov
items.text: Whoever's doing this, I will—
A thick branch smashes through the Committee Building's wall.

items.speaker: Soldier I
items.text: Wha—huh?

items.speaker: Druvis III
items.text: No need to be alarmed, soldiers. This thicket will provide you cover.

items.speaker: J
items.text: We figured you guys could use a couple arcanists on your side. Pretty sweet, huh? Hold on. Recoleta? What're you doing here?

items.speaker: Recoleta
items.text: At first, I only planned to observe and record the noble deeds and heroes of this great fight.

items.speaker: Recoleta
items.text: But I've had a change of heart.

items.speaker: Recoleta
items.text: I will join you in this fearless all-or-nothing adventure. I'll fight, just like everyone else. Please, let me stand by your side.

items.speaker: APPLe
items.text: Caution, everyone. Please clear a space around the light beam as quickly as possible.

items.speaker: Soldier II
items.text: Light beam?

items.speaker: Soldier II
items.text: Wait, there's something flying straight at us. Missile incoming.

items.speaker: Soldier I
items.text: You heard the apple. Move it!

items.speaker: Nautika
items.text: Ah!

items.speaker: Nautika
items.text: Did I ... Did I land right? Everyone okay?

items.speaker: Marsha
items.text: That was unlike any transport I've ever ridden before, Nautika.
Marsha suppresses the momentary exhilaration of the flight and focuses her mind on the battle.

items.speaker: Marsha
items.text: Don't worry. No injuries. Everyone moved away from the window. Excellent timing, Mr. APPLe. Now, do you remember what I said?

items.speaker: Nautika
items.text: Y-Yes, disrupt the enemy's coordination.

items.speaker: Manus Soldier I
items.text: A Chimera. It's the one from Antarctica. Then the rumors were true.

items.speaker: Krutov
items.text: If I hear another word from you, coward, I will personally put an end to you. That beast there is nothing more than an easy target.

items.speaker: Krutov
items.text: Now take her down!
Manus Vindictae's assault begins to slow as the Foundation's troops establish strong points along their lines.

items.speaker: Foundation Security
items.text: We can't thank you enough. You really saved our bacon back there.

items.speaker: Druvis III
items.text: There's a path down to the lower floor under this tree trunk. We can use it to move between floors behind enemy lines.

items.speaker: Foundation Security
items.text: Excellent news. Now we can send down teams to look for weapons and ammo.

items.speaker: Marsha
items.text: On that subject, we've brought supplies from Laplace. Nautika?

items.speaker: Nautika
items.text: Oh, right! I've got everything here.
Nautika shakes several silver packages from her back. A tin box clatters to the ground alongside them.

items.speaker: Tin Box
items.text: Ahem. Ahem.
He picks up the talking tin box.

items.speaker: Foundation Security
items.text: What's this?

items.speaker: Tin Box
items.text: Hi there, whoever you are, this is a prerecorded instructional message from X.

items.speaker: Tin Box
items.text: Now, allow me to walk you through the specifications of the equipment. First up: the semi-automatic construction arm.
The aftershocks of the battle for the third floor reverberate through the building, shaking both the higher and lower levels.

items.speaker: Ms. Stranger
items.text: Ms. Druvis has checked in. They've made it upstairs and joined the fight. I'm ready to set out for my mission as well.

items.speaker: Ms. Stranger
items.text: I'll be going behind enemy lines in an effort to find out how they breached our security. With any luck, I might find a way to close it and isolate their forces here.

items.speaker: Ms. Stranger
items.text: Researcher Marguerite, I'll leave the rest to you here.

items.speaker: Lorentz Butterfly
items.text: Not so fast. It's finally just the two of us. A good chance to speak face-to-face, don't you think?
The words momentarily take her away from thoughts of the battle ahead.

items.speaker: Lorentz Butterfly
items.text: Let's set aside this little "saving the world" matter for the moment and talk about what really matters. I've been waiting for this since the day I joined the "boon" research team.

items.speaker: Ms. Stranger
items.text: If this is about my past with the Manus ...

items.speaker: Lorentz Butterfly
items.text: No, no. I have no interest in that.

items.speaker: Lorentz Butterfly
items.text: Does the name "Loop Laboratory" ring a bell?

items.speaker: Ms. Stranger
items.text: You know about the Amber Room.
The color drains from her face.

items.speaker: Lorentz Butterfly
items.text: The secret lab built after the second "Storm" in collaboration between Zeno and the Foundation. Yes, I know about the Amber Room.

items.speaker: Lorentz Butterfly
items.text: I also know that, for years, Zeno has been tracking down soldiers reversed by the "Storm," labeling them as "deserters," and sending the Hush Troopers to ferry them to that very laboratory.

items.speaker: Lorentz Butterfly
items.text: And I know that using the same theory and reasoning behind the vessel ensoulment experiment, they developed a new technique.

items.speaker: Ms. Stranger
items.text: Phototaxis.

items.speaker: Ms. Stranger
items.text: A complex technique used to engrave a subject's skin and cerebral cortex with countless arcane incantations ...

items.speaker: Ms. Stranger
items.text: Enhancing their performance, resilience, and guaranteeing their unwavering loyalty.
Joy, terror, pain—the emotions stir in her mind like a deadly poison.

items.speaker: Lorentz Butterfly
items.text: Caring Cecilie, sweet Kayla, Grace the Specimen Enthusiast ... The Foundation has always kept you moving from one identity to another.

items.speaker: Ms. Stranger
items.text: There are many things I regret doing under those stolen names.

items.speaker: Lorentz Butterfly
items.text: But somehow your true self was never lost, not like with the others. I've been keeping my eye on that laboratory and its subjects. Most collapsed under the weight of their identities. But not you.

items.speaker: Lorentz Butterfly
items.text: It's no exaggeration to say you are the laboratory's finest work, a perfect specimen for Constantine's needs.

items.speaker: Ms. Stranger
items.text: That's quite enough. What do you want to say?

items.speaker: Lorentz Butterfly
items.text: There's a puzzle I've been looking to solve all these years. And only someone who survived that system can give me its final piece.

items.speaker: Lorentz Butterfly
items.text: You, Ms. Stranger, are the key to solving this mystery.

items.speaker: Lorentz Butterfly
items.text: I'd like to examine your brain to see whether it can rebuild your original self after the "Storm" washes it away.
A prolonged silence. But what breaks it isn't dispute, isn't indignation or concern. It's a light, almost sarcastic chuckle.

items.speaker: Ms. Stranger
items.text: I'm afraid you'll be disappointed, Ms. Marguerite. The Phototaxis is no longer in me.
Lorentz Butterfly is caught at a rare loss.

items.speaker: Lorentz Butterfly
items.text: Luck mocks me once again. But if that's so, then tell me: Who removed it?

items.speaker: Ms. Stranger
items.text: Arcana. She freed me from it in our confrontation earlier.

items.speaker: Lorentz Butterfly
items.text: She does seem quite taken by you, doesn't she? Her little pet. Maybe the Foundation should have let you stay by her side.

items.speaker: Ms. Stranger
items.text: It wasn't an act of kindness. She takes pleasure in the thought of me losing my mind, a mad dog off her leash, or collapsing once there's nothing left to hold me together.

items.speaker: Ms. Stranger
items.text: She let me live only to savor my misery.

items.speaker: Ms. Stranger
items.text: I suppose I should feel lucky to have regained my freedom, but it has come at a price—an emptiness that gnaws at me every waking moment.

items.speaker: Lorentz Butterfly
items.text: So, you have your freedom, yet you're still acting as if you're under the Foundation's control. Why is that, I wonder?

items.speaker: Ms. Stranger
items.text: I hate what they made me do—stealing people's names and lives. The guilt of it sits in my chest. But today, my choice is my own.

items.speaker: Lorentz Butterfly
items.text: You are a strange one, Ms. Stranger. You mean to say you're risking your life for the Foundation by choice?

items.speaker: Lorentz Butterfly
items.text: All the same, you've satisfied my curiosity, in a way. I suppose I should offer you something in return.
She smiles and hands over a mask that Ms. Stranger is all too familiar with.

items.speaker: Lorentz Butterfly
items.text: A friendly warning. This may corrupt you, and without the Phototaxis's protection, its effects could be permanent.

items.speaker: Ms. Stranger
items.text: Your warning is appreciated, truly, Researcher Marguerite.
